source: PreflopWidgets/PreflopWidgetContent.swift, Models/WidgetSharedState.swift. No widget screenshot exists in any repo (see screens/README.md). Display name 'Preflop'; description 'Your streak, and a hand worth answering right now.'; families small, medium, large. Widget font is the SYSTEM font (SF), not Hanken (extension bundles no fonts). Colours from PreflopWidgets/WidgetTheme.swift.

spot_row: situation line e.g. 'Facing an open' / 'Opening' / 'Blind vs blind'

two decision buttons: passive (Fold, or Check for BB vs limp) and the most aggressive live action, colour-coded like the table HUD (fold red, call blue, raise green) — colour says 'type of action', never 'the answer'

large_with_spot: seat pill + flame + streak number (top row)
hand title (15pt bold, e.g. 'A5s from the button' style handTitle) and context line
action path (the sequence of actions before hero)

hands_line_text.metered_free: '<n> hands left today' (CountLabel.hands; blank if unknown)

refresh: App writes a week of spots ahead; widget lays out 48h of entries so the hand rotates with the app closed. 'Today' is the local day.

widget_colours.note: Widget fold/raise/call differ slightly from in-app action colours.
